items: KATSINA STATE (PSI 9.3): Governor Radda Signs N828.58bn 2027 Budget; Approves 20MW Solar System to Save N7bn
LAGOS STATE (PSI 9.2): LASHMA-AID Saves 110 Lives in 6 Months; Lagos Launches EPPPS Digital Planning System
GOMBE STATE (PSI 9.1): Gombe Approves N10bn for Gratuity Liabilities; Secures 27 Armoured Brigade Military Formations
KADUNA STATE (PSI 8.9): Kaduna Begins Revitalisation of 82 PHCs; Recruits 1,000 Healthcare Workers
CROSS RIVER STATE (PSI 8.8): IDEAS-TVET Trains 1,225 Youths in Calabar; NEMA and CR-SEMA Distribute Disaster Supplies
OGUN STATE (PSI 8.7): Ogun Opens Discussions with NNPC to Revive $7bn Olokola LNG (OKLNG) Project
EBONYI STATE (PSI 8.6): Governor Nwifuru Receives NEMA Flood Relief for Akaeze and Ishiagu; Unveils History Book
IMO STATE (PSI 8.5): Governor Uzodimma Tasks Auditors-General on Value for Money; Receives Sun Award Notification
ABIA STATE (PSI 8.4): Governor Otti Hosts 2026 World Igbo Day; Expands Public School Construction Across 78 Sites
ADAMAWA STATE (PSI 8.3): Adamawa Housing Ministry Opens Bids for Four Major Public Construction Projects
KANO STATE (PSI 8.2): Kano Procurement Ministry Audits 40 Projects Worth N24bn; Orders Rectification on ICT Centres
EDO STATE (PSI 8.1): Edo Showcases Made-in-Edo Products at Abuja Trade Fair; Holds Knowledge-Sharing Series
KWARA STATE (PSI 8.0): Governor AbdulRazaq Donates N10m Relief to Lafiagi Flood Victims; Donates College Bus
AKWA IBOM STATE (PSI 7.9): Akwa Ibom Performs Groundbreaking for Ikot Ekpene International Market Project
PLATEAU STATE (PSI 7.8): Berom Youth Molders Demand Revocation of Latya Mining Lease ML-129
TARABA STATE (PSI 7.7): Governor Kefas Inspects TSBS and TTV Facilities; Pledges Complete Modernization
KATSINA (PSI 9.3): Signed the N828.58bn 2027 budget as first state nationwide, approved 20MW solar PV across 11 facilities to save N7bn, and launched N10,000 monthly stipends for 2,500 youths.
LAGOS (PSI 9.2): Treated 132 emergency cases saving 110 lives under LASHMA-AID, presented Safe Women Shelter SOPs, launched EPPPS digital building processing, and hosted Finland Ambassador.
GOMBE (PSI 9.1): Approved over N10bn to clear state/LGA gratuity backlogs (N36.5bn total), approved N6.1bn UBEC matching funds, and secured hosting of the new 27 Armoured Brigade HQ.
KADUNA (PSI 8.9): Commenced revitalisation of 82 PHCs with ambulances, approved recruitment of 1,000 health workers, and tasked newly inaugurated KSMC Board and Bureau of Statistics.
CROSS RIVER (PSI 8.8): Flagged off IDEAS-TVET training with N30,000 monthly stipends for 1,225 youths, distributed disaster relief items in Calabar, and deepened UNICAL aquaculture ties.
OGUN (PSI 8.7): Opened discussions with NNPC to revive the OKLNG project on 1,728 hectares, integrating it with the $7bn Gateway Deep Sea Port and Blue Marine Free Zone.
EBONYI (PSI 8.6): Received NEMA relief materials for flood victims in Akaeze and Ishiagu, and directed distribution of Prof. Onwe's 'Ebonyi Story' history book across public schools.
IMO (PSI 8.5): Delivered keynote address at the 55th Auditors-General Conference in Owerri emphasizing value for money, and received Sun Newspaper Man of the Year nomination.
ABIA (PSI 8.4): Hosted World Igbo Day in Umuahia advocating regional unity, while unveiling school construction and retrofitting across 78 locations alongside 20 Smart Schools.
ADAMAWA (PSI 8.3): Opened public bids with 12 contractors for 4 major projects including the new Deputy Governor's Office Complex and Yola Airport VIP Lounge.
KANO (PSI 8.2): Audited 40 projects worth N24.08bn across Gwarzo and Kabo LGAs, ordering immediate block quality rectifications at the Gwarzo ICT/CBT Centre.
EDO (PSI 8.1): Showcased Made-in-Edo products from 8 exhibitors at the 21st Abuja Trade Fair and hosted the 5th Public Service Knowledge-Sharing Series on workplace discipline.
KWARA (PSI 8.0): Donated N10m to flood-displaced communities in Lafiagi Emirate, directed SEMA to inventory losses, and presented a new coaster bus to CoE Technical Lafiagi.
AKWA IBOM (PSI 7.9): Performed groundbreaking for the Ikot Ekpene International Market featuring 30 double-deck blocks, 108 shops, cold storage, and dual asphalt/concrete access roads.
PLATEAU (PSI 7.8): Berom Youth Molders issued a 7-day ultimatum to authorities demanding revocation and investigation of Mining Lease ML-129 in Latya over community consent disputes.
TARABA (PSI 7.7): Inspected facilities at Taraba State Broadcasting Service and Taraba Television Corporation in Jalingo, pledging complete technical rehabilitation.
